narrative: Demand for PL1__M203A428 is continuous (99.2% non-zero) with a statistically significant upward trend and normal distribution (CV=0.39). Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.34) with one extreme outlier (9201.55 days) excluded. The (r,Q) policy with SS=2248 and Q=8964 achieves 95% service level within the 15,590-unit storage cap at 71.9% utilization.
warnings: Extreme lead time outlier detected and removed: 9201.55 days
Safety stock increase of 1369 units (+155.7%) required vs current SAP setting

research_insights.selection_rationale: Continuous demand regime (99.2% non-zero days) with normal distribution and moderate lead-time variability is the canonical fit for a fixed reorder-point / fixed-order-quantity (r,Q) model. EOQ provides the cost-minimising order quantity and the z-score buffer formula covers combined demand and lead-time uncertainty.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap of 15,590 units is not binding (SS+Q=11,212 = 71.9%). No capacity-driven reduction applied. If the upward demand trend continues, annual demand will grow and EOQ should be recalculated within 6 months.
